contact.heroSub: Have questions about a project, timeline, or pricing? We’re here to help.
contact.getText: Whether you have a detailed brief or just an idea, reach out via phone, email, or the contact form. We respond promptly during business days.
contact.formNote: We will get back to you during business days.
contact.errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
contact.errFormSummary: Please correct the highlighted fields and try again.
contact.errSpam: Message could not be sent. Please try again later.
contact.faqSub: Got questions before reaching out? Here are a few quick answers
contact.faq1Q: How long does it take to get a response?
contact.faq1A: We reply promptly during our standard business days. For urgent project adjustments, feel free to call us directly during office hours.
contact.faq2Q: Can we schedule a brief discovery call?
contact.faq2A: Absolutely. You can book a quick consultation right after submitting this form, or simply suggest your preferred times in the message field.
contact.faq3Q: What details should I include in my inquiry?
contact.faq3A: It helps to share the core objective of your product, the target audience, your timeline, and any reference links. Sharing an estimated budget also allows us to propose the best next steps.
contact.faq4Q: Do you collaborate with international clients?
contact.faq4A: Yes, we regularly work with clients worldwide. We manage remote delivery efficiently across different time zones and rely on clear, documented communication to keep everyone aligned.
contact.faq5A: Following our discovery phase, we provide a detailed project scope outlined with clear milestones and delivery dates. Development begins once this roadmap is approved.
contact.faq6Q: Can I request an estimate without a final project brief?
contact.faq6A: Yes, you can. We will provide a preliminary ballpark estimate first, and then deliver a fixed, final quote once the full scope and deliverables are confirmed.

terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions governing the use of the {{companyName}} website and software and technology services.
terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions govern your use of the {{companyName}} website and any software, web, AI, IoT, cloud, or cybersecurity services we provide. By accessing this site or engaging with our services, you agree to these terms.
terms.section1Content: By accessing or using the website and services of {{companyName}}, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our website or services.
terms.section2Content: {{companyName}} provides software and technology services including website and software development, artificial intelligence and automation, IoT and embedded systems, cloud and DevOps, and cybersecurity consulting. Scope, deliverables, timelines, and fees are defined in individual proposals or contracts.
terms.section3Content: Project work begins after written agreement on scope and commercial terms. Changes to scope may affect timeline and fees. We reserve the right to decline projects that conflict with our capacity, expertise, or policies.
terms.section4Content: Prices are as quoted in proposals or contracts. Payment schedules, currencies, and methods are agreed per engagement. Hosting, third-party licenses, and other pass-through costs may be billed separately when applicable.
terms.section5Content: Delivery milestones and support windows are defined in the relevant agreement. {{companyName}} is not liable for delays caused by client dependencies, third-party vendors, force majeure, or circumstances beyond our reasonable control.
terms.section6Content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, {{companyName}} shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the website or from our services, except where such limitation is prohibited.
terms.section7Content: Website content, branding, and pre-existing tools remain the property of {{companyName}} or its licensors. Custom project deliverables are transferred or licensed as stated in the applicable contract. You may not copy site materials without prior written permission.
terms.section8Content: These terms are governed by the laws of {{countryName}}. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of the jurisdiction in which {{companyName}} operates, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
terms.section9Content: We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised "Last updated" date. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance.
terms.section10Content: For questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us via the contact page or at info@asassoft.com.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy of {{companyName}} describing how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.intro: {{companyName}} is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our website or engage with our software and technology services.
privacy.section1Content: We may collect information you provide directly (name, email, phone, company, and message content when you contact us or request a quote), information from your use of our website (IP address, browser type, pages visited), and information from project communications and contracts.
privacy.section2Content: We use your information to respond to inquiries, deliver projects, communicate about proposals and support, improve our website and services, comply with legal obligations, and send relevant updates where you have consented.
privacy.section3Content: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, analyze site traffic, and remember preferences. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.section4Content: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with service providers (e.g., hosting, email, analytics) necessary to operate our business, with legal authorities when required by law, or in connection with a business transfer.
privacy.section5Content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure; we strive to protect your data in line with best practices.
privacy.section6Content: We retain your information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, to comply with legal obligations, or to resolve disputes.
privacy.section7Content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data, or to object to processing and to data portability. To exercise these rights, please contact us at info@asassoft.com.
privacy.section8Content: Your information may be processed in countries where we or our partners operate, including Syria and Türkiye. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place where required by applicable law.
privacy.section9Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the updated policy on this page and update the "Last updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.section10Content: For questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us via our contact page or at info@asassoft.com.
